uncertainObservations: Staff count: I read four uprights on each side of the doorway for eight planted, plus the one the figure carries. The outermost uprights on both sides sit close to the frame edge and in near-black, so a ninth or tenth planted upright just out of frame cannot be ruled out. Confidence is medium, not high.
The wrapping around the figure's head could be a bandage, a headband, or a crown of twisted material; I cannot tell which, and I cannot see whether it covers the eyes.
Whether the uprights are raw tree branches or shaped poles is unclear; their outlines are knotted and irregular.
The shape at the base of each upright reads as a low squared stone block but could be a stepped pedestal or a bundle of material.
I cannot tell whether the figure's lower end of the carried staff touches the ground.
The silhouettes seen through the gate are too small and low-contrast to confirm as buildings; one slender vertical reads as a tower.
The figure's garment: I cannot distinguish whether the tattered strips are a cloak worn over a tunic or a single shredded garment.
